short.en: Every cell slips its own way

t.zh: 这张地图上有的格子是冰，有的是地。地上不会滑；冰上每一格滑得不一样，角上写着打滑的可能。
t.en: Some cells on this map are ice and some are ground. Ground doesn’t slip; each cell of ice slips its own way, with its chance written in the corner.

t.zh: 本格信息里有打滑的可能和站稳的可能（两个加起来是 1）。往右 = 站稳 × 右边 + 打滑 × 下面；往下反过来。
t.en: This cell’s facts include its chance to slip and its chance to hold (they add up to 1). Going right = hold × right + slip × down; going down is the other way round.

goal.zh: 算出每一格的价值：两个动作里较好的那个 × 0.9，每个动作按这一格的打滑可能加权。
goal.en: Work out every cell’s value: the better of the two moves × 0.9, each move weighted by this cell’s chance to slip.

how.zh: 打滑的可能因格子而异：读本格信息，别用常数。
how.en: The chance to slip changes from cell to cell: read it from the cell’s facts, not from a Constant.

say.zh: 每一格滑得不一样：打滑和站稳的可能都要从本格信息里读。
say.en: Every cell slips its own way: read both chances from the cell’s facts.

say.zh: 按可能性加权要用乘法器。

hints.zh: 和<level-ref to="slip"></level-ref>一样，只是 0.8 和 0.2 换成了本格的「站稳的可能」和「打滑的可能」。
hints.en: As in <level-ref to="slip"></level-ref>, with 0.8 and 0.2 swapped for this cell’s “chance to hold” and “chance to slip”.

body.zh: 这块电路板读本格的可能。地上都是 0，它就是<level-ref to="treasure"></level-ref>；处处一样，它就是<level-ref to="slip"></level-ref>。
body.en: This board reads each cell’s own chances. With 0 everywhere it is <level-ref to="treasure"></level-ref>; with the same chance everywhere it is <level-ref to="slip"></level-ref>.

body.zh: 现实里的强化学习也是这样：环境的不确定性因状态而异，价值就按每个状态自己的可能性加权。
body.en: Real reinforcement learning works the same way: the uncertainty differs from state to state, and each value is weighted by that state’s own chances.
